companyName: Clearway Operating Solar Portfolio (12 U.S. projects, 50% interest)
legalName: Cardinal Portfolio JV; legal holdcos include Cardinal JV Purchaser LLC and the Fengate blocker vehicles
summary: Create one manager-level Cardinal Portfolio JV record. Direct SEC, FERC and sponsor evidence verifies a March 30, 2026 closed sponsor-equity transaction with Clearway Energy, Inc. and Fengate-managed vehicles holding 50% each. The JV is the 225-227 MW western subset, not the full 610-613 MW Cardinal portfolio or the broader Clearway platform. EIA independently verifies 13 operating plant records totaling 227.8 MW nameplate and 225.2 MW net-summer; the confidential mapping into 12 publicly reported assets is a noncritical disclosure gap.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The public sources do not identify which two EIA plant records aggregate into one of the 12 reported assets.
The split between Fengate's two blocker vehicles and Deriva/Manulife upstream economics is not publicly disclosed.
A complete project-level offtaker/PPA schedule is not publicly disclosed.
